items.text: Not much optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won’t go. Rams get Puka Nacua back.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practices; sources indicate low optimism.
items.implication: Eagles missing top WR vs Rams; Nacua returns boosts LAR pass game.
items.opportunity: PHI WR targets/routes to others; Nacua full role

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss at least 4 games.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach Kellen Moore confirmed IR.
items.implication: Misses at least next 4 games; opens larger role in NO backfield.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries shift to remaining RBs

items.text: Rams expect Puka Nacua (hip/groin) to return Sunday vs Eagles after limited practice; McVay confirmed expected to play.
items.why: Returned to limited practice; coach expects him.
items.implication: Major boost to LAR WR corps alongside Adams.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play this week (TNF); 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; believes in him despite short week.
items.why: Elite usage (90% snaps, near-monopoly touches); CLE allows RB yards.

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full on Thursday practice.
items.why: Upgraded from limited (Jackson back, Flowers hamstring).
items.implication: Both expected full go; positive for BAL offense.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes/targets for Flowers; Jackson mobility

items.text: After Etienne left Week 3, Kamara 50% snaps, Miller 30%, Donaldson 23%; expects 3-way committee, Kamara low-end flex.
items.why: Post-injury snap shares; IR locks in committee.
items.implication: Kamara lead but shared; Miller handcuff value.

items.text: No RB higher snap rate than Warren 90% last week; 20/22 touches with Dowdle out (likely misses again).
items.implication: Workhorse start for TNF/ROS while Dowdle out.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Notable high placement amid other adjustments.
items.why: ETR staff ROS Top 150 if drafting today; Walker #3.
items.implication: Strong ROS buy/hold signal for Walker.

items.text: Drake London LOVE: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows WR TDs.
items.why: Elite target share with Penix back; strong matchup.

items.text: Kyle Pitts HATE: 16% career target share/34 ypg with Penix; under 8 pts in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization.
items.why: Historically low volume/efficiency with Penix; poor utilization.
items.conflict: Conflicts with any residual hype from prior years

items.text: Justin Herbert HATE @ SEA: 44% pressure rate; SEA 4th pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA allowed; low implied total.
items.why: Tough matchup vs pressure/YPA defense; poor team total.

items.text: Zay Flowers: 29% snaps/14 routes Week 3 but 43% target rate on them, 30% share, 19.5 YPT; 41 FP on 37 snaps season.
items.why: Elite efficiency despite limited snaps; now full practice.
items.implication: High upside if volume rises with health.
items.opportunity: Target rate/YPT elite; full snaps potential

items.text: Prefer Jonathan Taylor side in 2-for-1 trade of Flowers + Montgomery for JT; want the '1' when close, and prefer JT.
items.why: ETR trade calculator/values favor JT as the stud.
items.implication: Acquire JT if possible; higher ROS value.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst relative to opportunity.
items.why: Low volume, no red-zone, underperformed opportunity chart.
items.implication: Avoid or bench; Penix pairing historically weak for Pitts.
